shared_elements: inscription-like sign sequences arranged in bands/lines
incised linear marking on a stone slab
justification: The only real correspondence is that both slabs carry rows of small script-like signs framed along parts of the surface. Otherwise A depicts a large naturalistic human figure in profile with elaborately modelled hair, beard, garment and raised hand, while B shows no figures at all, only abstract linear framing bands and a large arc/cross-like geometric motif; the manners of depiction (deep modelled relief vs thin flat incised line) are entirely different conventions.
